content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The record lists fifteen allegations and the agency's bare conclusion that Complainant 'failed to show that she was subjected to disparate treatment,' but cites no evidence (affidavits, witness statements, documents) and no reasoning linking any evidence to that conclusion."},"rc2":{"status":"gap","note":"Every incident is stated as an allegation without attribution to a source in the record (e.g., affidavit, witness statement, document), and the agency's findings cite no source at all, though a report of investigation is mentioned in passing."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Most allegations carry specific dates (e.g., Sept. 13, 2019; Dec. 24, 2019; Jan. 31, 2020; Feb. 6, 2020) and the complaint filing date of April 13, 2020 is given, but the dates of the Light Duty period, EEO counseling, report of investigation, and final decision are absent, and the claim 1 and 4 date ranges are vague."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not name who made the final decision, what standard was applied beyond a generic 'disparate treatment' reference, or whether the supervisors' explanations or other responsive information were considered before the decision."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Because evidence, sources, and decision-process details are missing, an independent reviewer could not assess whether the agency's no-discrimination conclusion is supported without outside context such as the full report of investigation."}}}
